policies.title: Chadian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Chad as Prior to Arrival, defined as a mission or consulate visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Chadian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Chadian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Chad in its authorized-visa cohort for advance immigration approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Chadian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district; final admission remains discretionary.

conflicts.explanation: The current full suspension preserves valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers, so it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The full suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes Puerto Rico. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
